11.bsb: (Mary, whose brother Lazarus was sick, was to anoint the Lord with perfume and wipe His feet with her hair.)

11.web: The sisters therefore sent to him, saying, “Lord, behold, he for whom you have great affection is sick.”
11.kjv: Therefore his sisters sent unto him, saying, Lord, behold, he whom thou lovest is sick.
11.bsb: So the sisters sent word to Jesus, “Lord, the one You love is sick.”

11.web: But when Jesus heard it, he said, “This sickness is not to death, but for the glory of God, that God’s Son may be glorified by it.”
11.kjv: When Jesus heard that , he said, This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.
11.bsb: When Jesus heard this, He said, “This sickness will not end in death. No, it is for the glory of God, so that the Son of God may be glorified through it.”

11.web: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.
11.kjv: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.
11.bsb: Now Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus.

11.web: When therefore he heard that he was sick, he stayed two days in the place where he was.
11.kjv: When he had heard therefore that he was sick, he abode two days still in the same place where he was.
11.bsb: So on hearing that Lazarus was sick, He stayed where He was for two days,

11.web: Then after this he said to the disciples, “Let’s go into Judea again.”
11.kjv: Then after that saith he to his disciples, Let us go into Judæa again.
11.bsb: and then He said to the disciples, “Let us go back to Judea.”

11.web: The disciples told him, “Rabbi, the Jews were just trying to stone you, and are you going there again?”
11.kjv: His disciples say unto him, Master, the Jews of late sought to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?
11.bsb: “Rabbi,” they replied, “the Jews just tried to stone You, and You are going back there?”

11.web: Jesus answered, “Aren’t there twelve hours of daylight? If a man walks in the day, he doesn’t stumble, because he sees the light of this world.
11.kjv: Jesus answered, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any man walk in the day, he stumbleth not, because he seeth the light of this world.
11.bsb: Jesus answered, “Are there not twelve hours of daylight? If anyone walks in the daytime, he will not stumble, because he sees by the light of this world.

11.web: But if a man walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light isn’t in him.”
11.kjv: But if a man walk in the night, he stumbleth, because there is no light in him.
11.bsb: But if anyone walks at night, he will stumble, because he has no light.”

11.web: He said these things, and after that, he said to them, “Our friend, Lazarus, has fallen asleep, but I am going so that I may awake him out of sleep.”
11.kjv: These things said he: and after that he saith unto them, Our friend Lazarus sleepeth; but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep.
11.bsb: After He had said this, He told them, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I am going there to wake him up.”

11.web: The disciples therefore said, “Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will recover.”
11.kjv: Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.
11.bsb: His disciples replied, “Lord, if he is sleeping, he will get better.”

11.web: Now Jesus had spoken of his death, but they thought that he spoke of taking rest in sleep.
11.kjv: Howbeit Jesus spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep.
11.bsb: They thought that Jesus was talking about actual sleep, but He was speaking about the death of Lazarus.

11.web: So Jesus said to them plainly then, “Lazarus is dead.
11.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.
11.bsb: So Jesus told them plainly, “Lazarus is dead,

11.web: I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, so that you may believe. Nevertheless, let’s go to him.”
11.kjv: And I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, to the intent ye may believe; nevertheless let us go unto him.
11.bsb: and for your sake I am glad I was not there, so that you may believe. But let us go to him.”

11.web: Thomas therefore, who is called Didymus, said to his fellow disciples, “Let’s go also, that we may die with him.”
11.kjv: Then said Thomas, which is called Didymus, unto his fellowdisciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.
11.bsb: Then Thomas called Didymus said to his fellow disciples, “Let us also go, so that we may die with Him.”

11.web: So when Jesus came, he found that he had been in the tomb four days already.
11.kjv: Then when Jesus came, he found that he had lain in the grave four days already.
11.bsb: When Jesus arrived, He found that Lazarus had already spent four days in the tomb.

11.web: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away.
11.kjv: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:
11.bsb: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, a little less than two miles away,

11.web: Many of the Jews had joined the women around Martha and Mary, to console them concerning their brother.
11.kjv: And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary, to comfort them concerning their brother.
11.bsb: and many of the Jews had come to Martha and Mary to console them in the loss of their brother.

11.web: Then when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went and met him, but Mary stayed in the house.
11.kjv: Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat still in the house.
11.bsb: So when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went out to meet Him; but Mary stayed at home.

11.web: Therefore Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.
11.kjv: Then said Martha unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
11.bsb: Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.

11.web: Even now I know that, whatever you ask of God, God will give you.”
11.kjv: But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give it thee.
11.bsb: But even now I know that God will give You whatever You ask of Him.”

11.web: Jesus said to her, “Your brother will rise again.”
11.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Thy brother shall rise again.
11.bsb: “Your brother will rise again,” Jesus told her.

11.web: Martha said to him, “I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”
11.kjv: Martha saith unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.
11.bsb: Martha replied, “I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”

11.web: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.
11.kjv: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
11.bsb: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in Me will live, even though he dies.

11.web: Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”
11.kjv: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?
11.bsb: And everyone who lives and believes in Me will never die. Do you believe this?”

11.web: She said to him, “Yes, Lord. I have come to believe that you are the Christ, God’s Son, he who comes into the world.”
11.kjv: She saith unto him, Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.
11.bsb: “Yes, Lord,” she answered, “I believe that You are the Christ, the Son of God, who was to come into the world.”

11.web: When she had said this, she went away, and called Mary, her sister, secretly, saying, “The Teacher is here, and is calling you.”
11.kjv: And when she had so said, she went her way, and called Mary her sister secretly, saying, The Master is come, and calleth for thee.
11.bsb: After Martha had said this, she went back and called her sister Mary aside to tell her, “The Teacher is here and is asking for you.”

11.web: When she heard this, she arose quickly, and went to him.
11.kjv: As soon as she heard that , she arose quickly, and came unto him.
11.bsb: And when Mary heard this, she got up quickly and went to Him.

11.web: Now Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was in the place where Martha met him.
11.kjv: Now Jesus was not yet come into the town, but was in that place where Martha met him.
11.bsb: Now Jesus had not yet entered the village, but was still at the place where Martha had met Him.

11.web: Then the Jews who were with her in the house, and were consoling her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up quickly and went out, followed her, saying, “She is going to the tomb to weep there.”
11.kjv: The Jews then which were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up hastily and went out, followed her, saying, She goeth unto the grave to weep there.
11.bsb: When the Jews who were in the house consoling Mary saw how quickly she got up and went out, they followed her, supposing she was going to the tomb to mourn there.

11.web: Therefore when Mary came to where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying to him, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.”
11.kjv: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.
11.bsb: When Mary came to Jesus and saw Him, she fell at His feet and said, “Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.”

11.web: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,
11.kjv: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews also weeping which came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,
11.bsb: When Jesus saw her weeping, and the Jews who had come with her also weeping, He was deeply moved in spirit and troubled.

11.web: and said, “Where have you laid him?” They told him, “Lord, come and see.”
11.kjv: And said, Where have ye laid him? They said unto him, Lord, come and see.
11.bsb: “Where have you put him?” He asked. “Come and see, Lord,” they answered.

11.web: Jesus wept.
11.kjv: Jesus wept.
11.bsb: Jesus wept.

11.web: The Jews therefore said, “See how much affection he had for him!”
11.kjv: Then said the Jews, Behold how he loved him!
11.bsb: Then the Jews said, “See how He loved him!”

11.web: Some of them said, “Couldn’t this man, who opened the eyes of him who was blind, have also kept this man from dying?”
11.kjv: And some of them said, Could not this man, which opened the eyes of the blind, have caused that even this man should not have died?
11.bsb: But some of them asked, “Could not this man who opened the eyes of the blind also have kept Lazarus from dying?”

11.web: Jesus therefore, again groaning in himself, came to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone lay against it.
11.kjv: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave. It was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.
11.bsb: Jesus, once again deeply moved, came to the tomb. It was a cave with a stone laid across the entrance.

11.web: Jesus said, “Take away the stone.” Martha, the sister of him who was dead, said to him, “Lord, by this time there is a stench, for he has been dead four days.”
11.kjv: Jesus said, Take ye away the stone. Martha, the sister of him that was dead, saith unto him, Lord, by this time he stinketh: for he hath been dead four days.
11.bsb: “Take away the stone,” Jesus said. “Lord, by now he stinks,” said Martha, the sister of the dead man. “It has already been four days.”

11.web: Jesus said to her, “Didn’t I tell you that if you believed, you would see God’s glory?”
11.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?
11.bsb: Jesus replied, “Did I not tell you that if you believed, you would see the glory of God?”

11.web: So they took away the stone from the place where the dead man was lying. Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, “Father, I thank you that you listened to me.
11.kjv: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me.
11.bsb: So they took away the stone. Then Jesus lifted His eyes upward and said, “Father, I thank You that You have heard Me.

11.web: I know that you always listen to me, but because of the multitude standing around I said this, that they may believe that you sent me.”
11.kjv: And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said it , that they may believe that thou hast sent me.
11.bsb: I knew that You always hear Me, but I say this for the benefit of the people standing here, so they may believe that You sent Me.”

11.web: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”
11.kjv: And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth.
11.bsb: After Jesus had said this, He called out in a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”

11.web: He who was dead came out, bound hand and foot with wrappings, and his face was wrapped around with a cloth. Jesus said to them, “Free him, and let him go.”
11.kjv: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.
11.bsb: The man who had been dead came out with his hands and feet bound in strips of linen, and his face wrapped in a cloth. “Unwrap him and let him go,” Jesus told them.

11.web: Therefore many of the Jews, who came to Mary and saw what Jesus did, believed in him.
11.kjv: Then many of the Jews which came to Mary, and had seen the things which Jesus did, believed on him.
11.bsb: Therefore many of the Jews who had come to Mary, and had seen what Jesus did, believed in Him.

11.web: But some of them went away to the Pharisees, and told them the things which Jesus had done.
11.kjv: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees, and told them what things Jesus had done.
11.bsb: But some of them went to the Pharisees and told them what Jesus had done.

11.web: The chief priests therefore and the Pharisees gathered a council, and said, “What are we doing? For this man does many signs.
11.kjv: Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles.
11.bsb: Then the chief priests and Pharisees convened the Sanhedrin and said, “What are we to do? This man is performing many signs.

11.web: If we leave him alone like this, everyone will believe in him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.”
11.kjv: If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.
11.bsb: If we let Him go on like this, everyone will believe in Him, and then the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.”

11.web: But a certain one of them, Caiaphas, being high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all,
11.kjv: And one of them, named Caiaphas, being the high priest that same year, said unto them, Ye know nothing at all,
11.bsb: But one of them, named Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all!

11.web: nor do you consider that it is advantageous for us that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation not perish.”
11.kjv: Nor consider that it is expedient for us, that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation perish not.
11.bsb: You do not realize that it is better for you that one man die for the people than that the whole nation perish.”

11.web: Now he didn’t say this of himself, but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation,
11.kjv: And this spake he not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for that nation;
11.bsb: Caiaphas did not say this on his own. Instead, as high priest that year, he was prophesying that Jesus would die for the nation,

11.web: and not for the nation only, but that he might also gather together into one the children of God who are scattered abroad.
11.kjv: And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of God that were scattered abroad.
11.bsb: and not only for the nation, but also for the scattered children of God, to gather them together into one.

11.web: So from that day forward they took counsel that they might put him to death.
11.kjv: Then from that day forth they took counsel together for to put him to death.
11.bsb: So from that day on they plotted to kill Him.

11.web: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews, but departed from there into the country near the wilderness, to a city called Ephraim. He stayed there with his disciples.
11.kjv: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews; but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness, into a city called Ephraim, and there continued with his disciples.
11.bsb: As a result, Jesus no longer went about publicly among the Jews, but He withdrew to a town called Ephraim in an area near the wilderness. And He stayed there with the disciples.

11.web: Now the Passover of the Jews was at hand. Many went up from the country to Jerusalem before the Passover, to purify themselves.
11.kjv: And the Jews’ passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.
11.bsb: Now the Jewish Passover was near, and many people went up from the country to Jerusalem to purify themselves before the Passover.

11.web: Then they sought for Jesus and spoke one with another, as they stood in the temple, “What do you think—that he isn’t coming to the feast at all?”
11.kjv: Then sought they for Jesus, and spake among themselves, as they stood in the temple, What think ye, that he will not come to the feast?
11.bsb: They kept looking for Jesus and asking one another as they stood in the temple courts, “What do you think? Will He come to the feast at all?”

11.web: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had commanded that if anyone knew where he was, he should report it, that they might seize him.
11.kjv: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment, that, if any man knew where he were, he should shew it , that they might take him.
11.bsb: But the chief priests and Pharisees had given orders that anyone who knew where He was must report it, so that they could arrest Him.

12.web: Then six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, who had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.
12.kjv: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.
12.bsb: Six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, the hometown of Lazarus, whom He had raised from the dead.

12.web: So they made him a supper there. Martha served, but Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with him.
12.kjv: There they made him a supper; and Martha served: but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him.
12.bsb: So they hosted a dinner for Jesus there. Martha served, and Lazarus was among those reclining at the table with Him.

12.web: Mary, therefore, took a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.
12.kjv: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment.
12.bsb: Then Mary took about a pint of expensive perfume, made of pure nard, and she anointed Jesus’ feet and wiped them with her hair. And the house was filled with the fragrance of the perfume.

12.web: Then Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, one of his disciples, who would betray him, said,
12.kjv: Then saith one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son , which should betray him,
12.bsb: But one of His disciples, Judas Iscariot, who was going to betray Him, asked,

12.web: “Why wasn’t this ointment sold for three hundred denarii, and given to the poor?”
12.kjv: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor?
12.bsb: “Why wasn’t this perfume sold for three hundred denarii and the money given to the poor?”

12.web: Now he said this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, used to steal what was put into it.
12.kjv: This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bare what was put therein.
12.bsb: Judas did not say this because he cared about the poor, but because he was a thief. As keeper of the money bag, he used to take from what was put into it.

12.web: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. She has kept this for the day of my burial.
12.kjv: Then said Jesus, Let her alone: against the day of my burying hath she kept this.
12.bsb: “Leave her alone,” Jesus replied. “She has kept this perfume in preparation for the day of My burial.

12.web: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.”
12.kjv: For the poor always ye have with you; but me ye have not always.
12.bsb: The poor you will always have with you, but you will not always have Me.”

12.web: A large crowd therefore of the Jews learned that he was there, and they came, not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
12.kjv: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
12.bsb: Meanwhile a large crowd of Jews learned that Jesus was there. And they came not only because of Him, but also to see Lazarus, whom He had raised from the dead.

12.web: But the chief priests conspired to put Lazarus to death also,
12.kjv: But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also to death;
12.bsb: So the chief priests made plans to kill Lazarus as well,

12.web: because on account of him many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus.
12.kjv: Because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.
12.bsb: for on account of him many of the Jews were deserting them and believing in Jesus.

12.web: On the next day a great multitude had come to the feast. When they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
12.kjv: On the next day much people that were come to the feast, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
12.bsb: The next day the great crowd that had come to the feast heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem.

12.web: they took the branches of the palm trees, and went out to meet him, and cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!”
12.kjv: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.
12.bsb: They took palm branches and went out to meet Him, shouting: “Hosanna!” “Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!” “Blessed is the King of Israel!”

12.web: Jesus, having found a young donkey, sat on it. As it is written,
12.kjv: And Jesus, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,
12.bsb: Finding a young donkey, Jesus sat on it, as it is written:

12.web: “Don’t be afraid, daughter of Zion. Behold, your King comes, sitting on a donkey’s colt.”
12.kjv: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass’s colt.
12.bsb: “Do not be afraid, O Daughter of Zion. See, your King is coming, seated on the colt of a donkey.”

12.web: His disciples didn’t understand these things at first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written about him, and that they had done these things to him.
12.kjv: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.
12.bsb: At first His disciples did not understand these things, but after Jesus was glorified they remembered what had been done to Him, and they realized that these very things had also been written about Him.

12.web: The multitude therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb, and raised him from the dead, was testifying about it.
12.kjv: The people therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of his grave, and raised him from the dead, bare record.
12.bsb: Meanwhile, many people continued to testify that they had been with Jesus when He called Lazarus from the tomb and raised him from the dead.

12.web: For this cause also the multitude went and met him, because they heard that he had done this sign.
12.kjv: For this cause the people also met him, for that they heard that he had done this miracle.
12.bsb: That is also why the crowd went out to meet Him, because they heard that He had performed this sign.

12.web: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, “See how you accomplish nothing. Behold, the world has gone after him.”
12.kjv: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.
12.bsb: Then the Pharisees said to one another, “You can see that this is doing you no good. Look how the whole world has gone after Him!”

12.web: Now there were certain Greeks among those that went up to worship at the feast.
12.kjv: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:
12.bsb: Now there were some Greeks among those who went up to worship at the feast.

12.web: These, therefore, came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”
12.kjv: The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.
12.bsb: They came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida in Galilee, and requested of him, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”

12.web: Philip came and told Andrew, and in turn, Andrew came with Philip, and they told Jesus.
12.kjv: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.
12.bsb: Philip relayed this appeal to Andrew, and both of them went and told Jesus.

12.web: Jesus answered them, “The time has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.
12.kjv: And Jesus answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.
12.bsb: But Jesus replied, “The hour has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.

12.web: Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.
12.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.
12.bsb: Truly, truly, I tell you, unless a kernel of wheat falls to the ground and dies, it remains only a seed; but if it dies, it bears much fruit.

12.web: He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.
12.kjv: He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.
12.bsb: Whoever loves his life will lose it, but whoever hates his life in this world will keep it for eternal life.

12.web: If anyone serves me, let him follow me. Where I am, there will my servant also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will honor him.
12.kjv: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.
12.bsb: If anyone serves Me, he must follow Me; and where I am, My servant will be as well. If anyone serves Me, the Father will honor him.

12.web: “Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this time?’ But for this cause I came to this time.
12.kjv: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.
12.bsb: Now My soul is troubled, and what shall I say? ‘Father, save Me from this hour’? No, it is for this purpose that I have come to this hour.

12.web: Father, glorify your name!” Then there came a voice out of the sky, saying, “I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.”
12.kjv: Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, saying , I have both glorified it , and will glorify it again.
12.bsb: Father, glorify Your name!” Then a voice came from heaven: “I have glorified it, and I will glorify it again.”

12.web: The multitude therefore, who stood by and heard it, said that it had thundered. Others said, “An angel has spoken to him.”
12.kjv: The people therefore, that stood by, and heard it , said that it thundered: others said, An angel spake to him.
12.bsb: The crowd standing there heard it and said that it had thundered. Others said that an angel had spoken to Him.

12.web: Jesus answered, “This voice hasn’t come for my sake, but for your sakes.
12.kjv: Jesus answered and said, This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.
12.bsb: In response, Jesus said, “This voice was not for My benefit, but yours.

12.web: Now is the judgment of this world. Now the prince of this world will be cast out.
12.kjv: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.
12.bsb: Now judgment is upon this world; now the prince of this world will be cast out.

12.web: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”
12.kjv: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.
12.bsb: And I, when I am lifted up from the earth, will draw everyone to Myself.”

12.web: But he said this, signifying by what kind of death he should die.
12.kjv: This he said, signifying what death he should die.
12.bsb: He said this to indicate the kind of death He was going to die.

12.web: The multitude answered him, “We have heard out of the law that the Christ remains forever. How do you say, ‘The Son of Man must be lifted up?’ Who is this Son of Man?”
12.kjv: The people answered him, We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?
12.bsb: The crowd replied, “We have heard from the Law that the Christ will remain forever. So how can you say that the Son of Man must be lifted up? Who is this Son of Man?”

12.web: Jesus therefore said to them, “Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness doesn’t overtake you. He who walks in the darkness doesn’t know where he is going.
12.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, Yet a little while is the light with you. Walk while ye have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.
12.bsb: Then Jesus told them, “For a little while longer, the Light will be among you. Walk while you have the Light, so that darkness will not overtake you. The one who walks in the darkness does not know where he is going.

12.web: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light.” Jesus said these things, and he departed and hid himself from them.
12.kjv: While ye have light, believe in the light, that ye may be the children of light. These things spake Jesus, and departed, and did hide himself from them.
12.bsb: While you have the Light, believe in the Light, so that you may become sons of light.” After Jesus had spoken these things, He went away and was hidden from them.

12.web: But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they didn’t believe in him,
12.kjv: But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:
12.bsb: Although Jesus had performed so many signs in their presence, they still did not believe in Him.

12.web: that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke, “Lord, who has believed our report? To whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”
12.kjv: That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, Lord, who hath believed our report? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed?
12.bsb: This was to fulfill the word of Isaiah the prophet: “Lord, who has believed our message? And to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”

12.web: For this cause they couldn’t believe, for Isaiah said again,
12.kjv: Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again,
12.bsb: For this reason they were unable to believe. For again, Isaiah says:

12.web: “He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart, lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their heart, and would turn, and I would heal them.”
12.kjv: He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.
12.bsb: “He has blinded their eyes and hardened their hearts, so that they cannot see with their eyes, and understand with their hearts, and turn, and I would heal them.”

12.web: Isaiah said these things when he saw his glory, and spoke of him.
12.kjv: These things said Esaias, when he saw his glory, and spake of him.
12.bsb: Isaiah said these things because he saw Jesus’ glory and spoke about Him.

12.web: Nevertheless even of the rulers many believed in him, but because of the Pharisees they didn’t confess it, so that they wouldn’t be put out of the synagogue,
12.kjv: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him , lest they should be put out of the synagogue:
12.bsb: Nevertheless, many of the leaders believed in Him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess Him, for fear that they would be put out of the synagogue.

12.web: for they loved men’s praise more than God’s praise.
12.kjv: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.
12.bsb: For they loved praise from men more than praise from God.

12.web: Jesus cried out and said, “Whoever believes in me, believes not in me, but in him who sent me.
12.kjv: Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.
12.bsb: Then Jesus cried out, “Whoever believes in Me does not believe in Me alone, but in the One who sent Me.

12.web: He who sees me sees him who sent me.
12.kjv: And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me.
12.bsb: And whoever sees Me sees the One who sent Me.

12.web: I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.
12.kjv: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.
12.bsb: I have come into the world as a light, so that no one who believes in Me should remain in darkness.

12.web: If anyone listens to my sayings, and doesn’t believe, I don’t judge him. For I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
12.kjv: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
12.bsb: As for anyone who hears My words and does not keep them, I do not judge him. For I have not come to judge the world, but to save the world.

12.web: He who rejects me, and doesn’t receive my sayings, has one who judges him. The word that I spoke, the same will judge him in the last day.
12.kjv: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.
12.bsb: There is a judge for the one who rejects Me and does not receive My words: The word that I have spoken will judge him on the last day.

12.web: For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.
12.kjv: For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.
12.bsb: I have not spoken on My own, but the Father who sent Me has commanded Me what to say and how to say it.

12.web: I know that his commandment is eternal life. The things therefore which I speak, even as the Father has said to me, so I speak.”
12.kjv: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.
12.bsb: And I know that His command leads to eternal life. So I speak exactly what the Father has told Me to say.”

13.web: Now before the feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his time had come that he would depart from this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.
13.kjv: Now before the feast of the passover, when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end.
13.bsb: It was now just before the Passover Feast, and Jesus knew that His hour had come to leave this world and return to the Father. Having loved His own who were in the world, He loved them to the very end.

13.web: During supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him,
13.kjv: And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son , to betray him;
13.bsb: The evening meal was underway, and the devil had already put into the heart of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, to betray Jesus.

13.web: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came from God, and was going to God,
13.kjv: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God;
13.bsb: Jesus knew that the Father had delivered all things into His hands, and that He had come from God and was returning to God.

13.web: arose from supper, and laid aside his outer garments. He took a towel, and wrapped a towel around his waist.
13.kjv: He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.
13.bsb: So He got up from the supper, laid aside His outer garments, and wrapped a towel around His waist.

13.web: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples’ feet, and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him.
13.kjv: After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples’ feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.
13.bsb: After that, He poured water into a basin and began to wash the disciples’ feet and dry them with the towel that was around Him.

13.web: Then he came to Simon Peter. He said to him, “Lord, do you wash my feet?”
13.kjv: Then cometh he to Simon Peter: and Peter saith unto him, Lord, dost thou wash my feet?
13.bsb: He came to Simon Peter, who asked Him, “Lord, are You going to wash my feet?”

13.web: Jesus answered him, “You don’t know what I am doing now, but you will understand later.”
13.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.
13.bsb: Jesus replied, “You do not realize now what I am doing, but later you will understand.”

13.web: Peter said to him, “You will never wash my feet!” Jesus answered him, “If I don’t wash you, you have no part with me.”
13.kjv: Peter saith unto him, Thou shalt never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.
13.bsb: “Never shall You wash my feet!” Peter told Him. Jesus answered, “Unless I wash you, you have no part with Me.”

13.web: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!”
13.kjv: Simon Peter saith unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head.
13.bsb: “Then, Lord,” Simon Peter replied, “not only my feet, but my hands and my head as well!”

13.web: Jesus said to him, “Someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed, but is completely clean. You are clean, but not all of you.”
13.kjv: Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.
13.bsb: Jesus told him, “Whoever has already bathed needs only to wash his feet, and he will be completely clean. And you are clean, though not all of you.”

13.web: For he knew him who would betray him, therefore he said, “You are not all clean.”
13.kjv: For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, Ye are not all clean.
13.bsb: For He knew who would betray Him. That is why He said, “Not all of you are clean.”

13.web: So when he had washed their feet, put his outer garment back on, and sat down again, he said to them, “Do you know what I have done to you?
13.kjv: So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said unto them, Know ye what I have done to you?
13.bsb: When Jesus had washed their feet and put on His outer garments, He reclined with them again and asked, “Do you know what I have done for you?

13.web: You call me, ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord.’ You say so correctly, for so I am.
13.kjv: Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.
13.bsb: You call Me Teacher and Lord, and rightly so, because I am.

13.web: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.
13.kjv: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another’s feet.
13.bsb: So if I, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also should wash one another’s feet.

13.web: For I have given you an example, that you also should do as I have done to you.
13.kjv: For I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you.
13.bsb: I have set you an example so that you should do as I have done for you.

13.web: Most certainly I tell you, a servant is not greater than his lord, neither one who is sent greater than he who sent him.
13.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him.
13.bsb: Truly, truly, I tell you, no servant is greater than his master, nor is a messenger greater than the one who sent him.

13.web: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.
13.kjv: If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.
13.bsb: If you know these things, you will be blessed if you do them.

13.web: I don’t speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen. But that the Scripture may be fulfilled, ‘He who eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.’
13.kjv: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me.
13.bsb: I am not speaking about all of you; I know whom I have chosen. But this is to fulfill the Scripture: ‘The one who shares My bread has lifted up his heel against Me.’

13.web: From now on, I tell you before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that I am he.
13.kjv: Now I tell you before it come, that, when it is come to pass, ye may believe that I am he .
13.bsb: I am telling you now before it happens, so that when it comes to pass, you will believe that I am He.

13.web: Most certainly I tell you, he who receives whomever I send, receives me; and he who receives me, receives him who sent me.”
13.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me; and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
13.bsb: Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever receives the one I send receives Me, and whoever receives Me receives the One who sent Me.”

13.web: When Jesus had said this, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”
13.kjv: When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
13.bsb: After Jesus had said this, He became troubled in spirit and testified, “Truly, truly, I tell you, one of you will betray Me.”

13.web: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed about whom he spoke.
13.kjv: Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.
13.bsb: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed as to which of them He meant.

13.web: One of his disciples, whom Jesus loved, was at the table, leaning against Jesus’ breast.
13.kjv: Now there was leaning on Jesus’ bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.
13.bsb: One of His disciples, the one whom Jesus loved, was reclining at His side.

13.web: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, and said to him, “Tell us who it is of whom he speaks.”
13.kjv: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake.
13.bsb: So Simon Peter motioned to him to ask Jesus which one He was talking about.

13.web: He, leaning back, as he was, on Jesus’ breast, asked him, “Lord, who is it?”
13.kjv: He then lying on Jesus’ breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?
13.bsb: Leaning back against Jesus, he asked, “Lord, who is it?”

13.web: Jesus therefore answered, “It is he to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it.” So when he had dipped the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.
13.kjv: Jesus answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a sop, when I have dipped it . And when he had dipped the sop, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.
13.bsb: Jesus answered, “It is the one to whom I give this morsel after I have dipped it.” Then He dipped the morsel and gave it to Judas son of Simon Iscariot.

13.web: After the piece of bread, then Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to him, “What you do, do quickly.”
13.kjv: And after the sop Satan entered into him. Then said Jesus unto him, That thou doest, do quickly.
13.bsb: And when Judas had taken the morsel, Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to Judas, “What you are about to do, do quickly.”

13.web: Now no man at the table knew why he said this to him.
13.kjv: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.
13.bsb: But no one at the table knew why Jesus had said this to him.

13.web: For some thought, because Judas had the money box, that Jesus said to him, “Buy what things we need for the feast,” or that he should give something to the poor.
13.kjv: For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said unto him, Buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor.
13.bsb: Since Judas kept the money bag, some thought that Jesus was telling him to buy what was needed for the feast, or to give something to the poor.

13.web: Therefore having received that morsel, he went out immediately. It was night.
13.kjv: He then having received the sop went immediately out: and it was night.
13.bsb: As soon as he had received the morsel, Judas went out into the night.

13.web: When he had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.
13.kjv: Therefore, when he was gone out, Jesus said, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him.
13.bsb: When Judas had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man is glorified, and God is glorified in Him.

13.web: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.
13.kjv: If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.
13.bsb: If God is glorified in Him, God will also glorify the Son in Himself—and will glorify Him at once.

13.web: Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come,’ so now I tell you.
13.kjv: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. Ye shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Whither I go, ye cannot come; so now I say to you.
13.bsb: Little children, I am with you only a little while longer. You will look for Me, and as I said to the Jews, so now I say to you: ‘Where I am going, you cannot come.’

13.web: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.
13.kjv: A new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another; as I have loved you, that ye also love one another.
13.bsb: A new commandment I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you also must love one another.

13.web: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”
13.kjv: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
13.bsb: By this everyone will know that you are My disciples, if you love one another.”

13.web: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you can’t follow now, but you will follow afterwards.”
13.kjv: Simon Peter said unto him, Lord, whither goest thou? Jesus answered him, Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now; but thou shalt follow me afterwards.
13.bsb: “Lord, where are You going?” Simon Peter asked. Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you cannot follow Me now, but you will follow later.”

13.web: Peter said to him, “Lord, why can’t I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.”
13.kjv: Peter said unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow thee now? I will lay down my life for thy sake.
13.bsb: “Lord,” said Peter, “why can’t I follow You now? I will lay down my life for You.”

13.web: Jesus answered him, “Will you lay down your life for me? Most certainly I tell you, the rooster won’t crow until you have denied me three times.
13.kjv: Jesus answered him, Wilt thou lay down thy life for my sake? Verily, verily, I say unto thee, The cock shall not crow, till thou hast denied me thrice.
13.bsb: “Will you lay down your life for Me?” Jesus replied. “Truly, truly, I tell you, before the rooster crows, you will deny Me three times.

14.web: “Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
14.kjv: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.
14.bsb: “Do not let your hearts be troubled. You believe in God; believe in Me as well.

14.web: In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.
14.kjv: In my Father’s house are many mansions: if it were not so , I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
14.bsb: In My Father’s house are many rooms. If it were not so, would I have told you that I am going there to prepare a place for you?

14.web: If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.
14.kjv: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.
14.bsb: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come back and welcome you into My presence, so that you also may be where I am.

14.web: Where I go, you know, and you know the way.”
14.kjv: And whither I go ye know, and the way ye know.
14.bsb: You know the way to the place where I am going.”

14.web: Thomas said to him, “Lord, we don’t know where you are going. How can we know the way?”
14.kjv: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; and how can we know the way?
14.bsb: “Lord,” said Thomas, “we do not know where You are going, so how can we know the way?”

14.web: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.
14.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.
14.bsb: Jesus answered, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.

14.web: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on, you know him, and have seen him.”
14.kjv: If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.
14.bsb: If you had known Me, you would know My Father as well. From now on you do know Him and have seen Him.”

14.web: Philip said to him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”
14.kjv: Philip saith unto him, Lord, shew us the Father, and it sufficeth us.
14.bsb: Philip said to Him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”

14.web: Jesus said to him, “Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen the Father. How do you say, ‘Show us the Father?’
14.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet hast thou not known me, Philip? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father; and how sayest thou then , Shew us the Father?
14.bsb: Jesus replied, “Philip, I have been with you all this time, and still you do not know Me? Anyone who has seen Me has seen the Father. How can you say, ‘Show us the Father’?

14.web: Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself; but the Father who lives in me does his works.
14.kjv: Believest thou not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwelleth in me, he doeth the works.
14.bsb: Do you not believe that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me? The words I say to you, I do not speak on My own. Instead, it is the Father dwelling in Me, performing His works.

14.web: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me; or else believe me for the very works’ sake.
14.kjv: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works’ sake.
14.bsb: Believe Me that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me—or at least believe on account of the works themselves.

14.web: Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works than these, because I am going to my Father.
14.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believeth on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father.
14.bsb: Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever believes in Me will also do the works that I am doing. He will do even greater things than these, because I am going to the Father.

14.web: Whatever you will ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
14.kjv: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
14.bsb: And I will do whatever you ask in My name, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

14.web: If you will ask anything in my name, I will do it.
14.kjv: If ye shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it.
14.bsb: If you ask Me for anything in My name, I will do it.

14.web: If you love me, keep my commandments.
14.kjv: If ye love me, keep my commandments.
14.bsb: If you love Me, you will keep My commandments.

14.web: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever,—
14.kjv: And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever;
14.bsb: And I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Advocate to be with you forever—

14.web: the Spirit of truth, whom the world can’t receive; for it doesn’t see him, neither knows him. You know him, for he lives with you, and will be in you.
14.kjv: Even the Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, neither knoweth him: but ye know him; for he dwelleth with you, and shall be in you.
14.bsb: the Spirit of truth. The world cannot receive Him, because it neither sees Him nor knows Him. But you do know Him, for He abides with you and will be in you.

14.web: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.
14.kjv: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.
14.bsb: I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.

14.web: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.
14.kjv: Yet a little while, and the world seeth me no more; but ye see me: because I live, ye shall live also.
14.bsb: In a little while the world will see Me no more, but you will see Me. Because I live, you also will live.

14.web: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.
14.kjv: At that day ye shall know that I am in my Father, and ye in me, and I in you.
14.bsb: On that day you will know that I am in My Father, and you are in Me, and I am in you.

14.web: One who has my commandments, and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him.”
14.kjv: He that hath my commandments, and keepeth them, he it is that loveth me: and he that loveth me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him.
14.bsb: Whoever has My commandments and keeps them is the one who loves Me. The one who loves Me will be loved by My Father, and I will love him and reveal Myself to him.”

14.web: Judas (not Iscariot) said to him, “Lord, what has happened that you are about to reveal yourself to us, and not to the world?”
14.kjv: Judas saith unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?
14.bsb: Judas (not Iscariot) asked Him, “Lord, why are You going to reveal Yourself to us and not to the world?”

14.web: Jesus answered him, “If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him, and make our home with him.
14.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him.
14.bsb: Jesus replied, “If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word. My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our home with him.

14.web: He who doesn’t love me doesn’t keep my words. The word which you hear isn’t mine, but the Father’s who sent me.
14.kjv: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father’s which sent me.
14.bsb: Whoever does not love Me does not keep My words. The word that you hear is not My own, but it is from the Father who sent Me.

14.web: I have said these things to you, while still living with you.
14.kjv: These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.
14.bsb: All this I have spoken to you while I am still with you.

14.web: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.
14.kjv: But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.
14.bsb: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, will teach you all things and will remind you of everything I have told you.

14.web: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, give I to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
14.kjv: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
14.bsb: Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled; do not be afraid.

14.web: You heard how I told you, ‘I go away, and I come to you.’ If you loved me, you would have rejoiced, because I said ‘I am going to my Father;’ for the Father is greater than I.
14.kjv: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.
14.bsb: You heard Me say, ‘I am going away, and I am coming back to you.’ If you loved Me, you would rejoice that I am going to the Father, because the Father is greater than I.

14.web: Now I have told you before it happens so that, when it happens, you may believe.
14.kjv: And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it is come to pass, ye might believe.
14.bsb: And now I have told you before it happens, so that when it does happen, you will believe.

14.web: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.
14.kjv: Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world cometh, and hath nothing in me.
14.bsb: I will not speak with you much longer, for the prince of this world is coming, and he has no claim on Me.

14.web: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, let us go from here.
14.kjv: But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go hence.
14.bsb: But I do exactly what the Father has commanded Me, so that the world may know that I love the Father. Get up! Let us go on from here.

15.web: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.
15.kjv: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.
15.bsb: “I am the true vine, and My Father is the keeper of the vineyard.

15.web: Every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.
15.kjv: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every branch that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.
15.bsb: He cuts off every branch in Me that bears no fruit, and every branch that does bear fruit, He prunes to make it even more fruitful.

15.web: You are already pruned clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.
15.kjv: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.
15.bsb: You are already clean because of the word I have spoken to you.

15.web: Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself, unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.
15.kjv: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.
15.bsb: Remain in Me, and I will remain in you. Just as no branch can bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, neither can you bear fruit unless you remain in Me.

15.web: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me, and I in him, the same bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.
15.kjv: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
15.bsb: I am the vine and you are the branches. The one who remains in Me, and I in him, will bear much fruit. For apart from Me you can do nothing.

15.web: If a man doesn’t remain in me, he is thrown out as a branch, and is withered; and they gather them, throw them into the fire, and they are burned.
15.kjv: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned.
15.bsb: If anyone does not remain in Me, he is like a branch that is thrown away and withers. Such branches are gathered up, thrown into the fire, and burned.

15.web: If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.
15.kjv: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.
15.bsb: If you remain in Me and My words remain in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.

15.web: “In this is my Father glorified, that you bear much fruit; and so you will be my disciples.
15.kjv: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.
15.bsb: This is to My Father’s glory, that you bear much fruit, proving yourselves to be My disciples.

15.web: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.
15.kjv: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.
15.bsb: As the Father has loved Me, so have I loved you. Remain in My love.

15.web: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love; even as I have kept my Father’s commandments, and remain in his love.
15.kjv: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father’s commandments, and abide in his love.
15.bsb: If you keep My commandments, you will remain in My love, just as I have kept My Father’s commandments and remain in His love.

15.web: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.
15.kjv: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.
15.bsb: I have told you these things so that My joy may be in you and your joy may be complete.

15.web: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.
15.kjv: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.
15.bsb: This is My commandment, that you love one another as I have loved you.

15.web: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.
15.kjv: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
15.bsb: Greater love has no one than this, that he lay down his life for his friends.

15.web: You are my friends, if you do whatever I command you.
15.kjv: Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.
15.bsb: You are My friends if you do what I command you.

15.web: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.
15.kjv: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.
15.bsb: No longer do I call you servants, for a servant does not understand what his master is doing. But I have called you friends, because everything I have learned from My Father I have made known to you.

15.web: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you, and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.
15.kjv: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.
15.bsb: You did not choose Me, but I chose you. And I appointed you to go and bear fruit—fruit that will remain—so that whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.

15.web: “I command these things to you, that you may love one another.
15.kjv: These things I command you, that ye love one another.
15.bsb: This is My command to you: Love one another.

15.web: If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.
15.kjv: If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you.
15.bsb: If the world hates you, understand that it hated Me first.

15.web: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, since I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.
15.kjv: If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.
15.bsb: If you were of the world, it would love you as its own. Instead, the world hates you, because you are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world.

15.web: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his lord.’ If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will also keep yours.
15.kjv: Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.
15.bsb: Remember the word that I spoke to you: ‘No servant is greater than his master.’ If they persecuted Me, they will persecute you as well; if they kept My word, they will keep yours as well.

15.web: But all these things will they do to you for my name’s sake, because they don’t know him who sent me.
15.kjv: But all these things will they do unto you for my name’s sake, because they know not him that sent me.
15.bsb: But they will treat you like this because of My name, since they do not know the One who sent Me.

15.web: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.
15.kjv: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloke for their sin.
15.bsb: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. Now, however, they have no excuse for their sin.

15.web: He who hates me, hates my Father also.
15.kjv: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.
15.bsb: Whoever hates Me hates My Father as well.

15.web: If I hadn’t done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn’t have had sin. But now have they seen and also hated both me and my Father.
15.kjv: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.
15.bsb: If I had not done among them the works that no one else did, they would not be guilty of sin; but now they have seen and hated both Me and My Father.

15.web: But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’
15.kjv: But this cometh to pass , that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.
15.bsb: But this is to fulfill what is written in their Law: ‘They hated Me without reason.’

15.web: “When the Counselor has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.
15.kjv: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me:
15.bsb: When the Advocate comes, whom I will send to you from the Father—the Spirit of truth who proceeds from the Father—He will testify about Me.

15.web: You will also testify, because you have been with me from the beginning.
15.kjv: And ye also shall bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.
15.bsb: And you also must testify, because you have been with Me from the beginning.

16.web: “I have said these things to you so that you wouldn’t be caused to stumble.
16.kjv: These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be offended.
16.bsb: “I have told you these things so that you will not fall away.

16.web: They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time comes that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God.
16.kjv: They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time cometh, that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service.
16.bsb: They will put you out of the synagogues. In fact, a time is coming when anyone who kills you will think he is offering a service to God.

16.web: They will do these things because they have not known the Father, nor me.
16.kjv: And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me.
16.bsb: They will do these things because they have not known the Father or Me.

16.web: But I have told you these things, so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn’t tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.
16.kjv: But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, ye may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you.
16.bsb: But I have told you these things so that when their hour comes, you will remember that I told you about them. I did not tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.

16.web: But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’
16.kjv: But now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asketh me, Whither goest thou?
16.bsb: Now, however, I am going to Him who sent Me; yet none of you asks Me, ‘Where are You going?’

16.web: But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.
16.kjv: But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow hath filled your heart.
16.bsb: Instead, your hearts are filled with sorrow because I have told you these things.

16.web: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away, for if I don’t go away, the Counselor won’t come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.
16.kjv: Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you.
16.bsb: But I tell you the truth, it is for your benefit that I am going away. Unless I go away, the Advocate will not come to you; but if I go, I will send Him to you.

16.web: When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;
16.kjv: And when he is come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment:
16.bsb: And when He comes, He will convict the world in regard to sin and righteousness and judgment:

16.web: about sin, because they don’t believe in me;
16.kjv: Of sin, because they believe not on me;
16.bsb: in regard to sin, because they do not believe in Me;

16.web: about righteousness, because I am going to my Father, and you won’t see me any more;
16.kjv: Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and ye see me no more;
16.bsb: in regard to righteousness, because I am going to the Father and you will no longer see Me;

16.web: about judgment, because the prince of this world has been judged.
16.kjv: Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.
16.bsb: and in regard to judgment, because the prince of this world has been condemned.

16.web: “I have yet many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.
16.kjv: I have yet many things to say unto you, but ye cannot bear them now.
16.bsb: I still have much to tell you, but you cannot yet bear to hear it.

16.web: However when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.
16.kjv: Howbeit when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will shew you things to come.
16.bsb: However, when the Spirit of truth comes, He will guide you into all truth. For He will not speak on His own, but He will speak what He hears, and He will declare to you what is to come.

16.web: He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine, and will declare it to you.
16.kjv: He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
16.bsb: He will glorify Me by taking from what is Mine and disclosing it to you.

16.web: All things whatever the Father has are mine; therefore I said that he takes of mine, and will declare it to you.
16.kjv: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
16.bsb: Everything that belongs to the Father is Mine. That is why I said that the Spirit will take from what is Mine and disclose it to you.

16.web: A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me.”
16.kjv: A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me, because I go to the Father.
16.bsb: In a little while you will see Me no more, and then after a little while you will see Me.”

16.web: Some of his disciples therefore said to one another, “What is this that he says to us, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me;’ and, ‘Because I go to the Father’?”
16.kjv: Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he saith unto us, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father?
16.bsb: Then some of His disciples asked one another, “Why is He telling us, ‘In a little while you will not see Me, and then after a little while you will see Me’ and ‘Because I am going to the Father’?”

16.web: They said therefore, “What is this that he says, ‘A little while’? We don’t know what he is saying.”
16.kjv: They said therefore, What is this that he saith, A little while? we cannot tell what he saith.
16.bsb: They kept asking, “Why is He saying, ‘a little while’? We do not understand what He is saying.”

16.web: Therefore Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, “Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me?’
16.kjv: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said unto them, Do ye enquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and ye shall not see me: and again, a little while, and ye shall see me?
16.bsb: Aware that they wanted to question Him, Jesus said to them, “Are you asking one another why I said, ‘In a little while you will not see Me, and then after a little while you will see Me’?

16.web: Most certainly I tell you, that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.
16.kjv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, That ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.
16.bsb: Truly, truly, I tell you, you will weep and wail while the world rejoices. You will grieve, but your grief will turn to joy.

16.web: A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow, because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn’t remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.
16.kjv: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow, because her hour is come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembereth no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world.
16.bsb: A woman has pain in childbirth because her time has come; but when she brings forth her child, she forgets her anguish because of her joy that a child has been born into the world.

16.web: Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.
16.kjv: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.
16.bsb: So also you have sorrow now, but I will see you again and your hearts will rejoice, and no one will take away your joy.

16.web: “In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.
16.kjv: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you.
16.bsb: In that day you will no longer ask Me anything. Truly, truly, I tell you, whatever you ask the Father in My name, He will give you.

16.web: Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.
16.kjv: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.
